dedupe_keys.name: lignes souterraines hta enedis en france

description: Lignes souterraines HTA Enedis en France is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.enedis.fr. This data set represents the position of the medium-voltage underground lines (HTA) over the entire distribution network operated by Enedis. It comes from the opendata Enedis version of January 2021. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Underground lines HTA Enedis in France" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include HTA, moyenne tension, France, données ouvertes, lignes, Réseau souterrain électrique. The listing shows 2021-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
